run_clip_evals_with_lora: run CLIP evaluation on a LoRA-finetuned model across ARO, VLC, Winoground, Elevater, and Dense Cap benchmarks
run_aro_evals: run ARO benchmark evaluations on a loaded CLIP model with its processor
run_vlc_evals: run VLC benchmark evaluations on a loaded CLIP model with its processor and model name
run_winoground_evals: run Winoground benchmark evaluations on a loaded CLIP model with its processor
run_elevater_evals: run Elevater benchmark evaluations with specified shot options and dataset on a loaded CLIP model
